entities.name: Aymara Kingdoms (Señoríos) After Tiwanaku
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: After Tiwanaku's collapse, multiple Aymara-speaking kingdoms (señoríos) — including the Colla, Lupaca, Pacajes, and Charca — emerged across the altiplano. These warring polities built hilltop fortifications (pukaras), maintained extensive camelid herds, and controlled vertical archipelago exchange n
